prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity shippable 16:9 desktop homepage direction comp for VEEMAP Technologies
Input images: Image 1 is the visual-system quality bar for night-navy quilt and embroidered-gold interface craft; Image 2 is the hero-composition quality bar for folded districts and stitched map hierarchy; Image 3 is the authoritative VEEMAP orange-and-green double-chevron logo and must be preserved accurately, not redesigned.
Primary request: Design a bold VEEMAP Technologies homepage that transforms a recognizably industrial special-purpose automation machine into a night-shift factory map. A conceptually accurate, non-proprietary high-speed machine is the exact central object: rigid frame, safety guarding, conveyors, servo pick-and-place mechanism, inspection camera, HMI and precision work nests. Its large machine body is rendered as tactile night-navy quilted technical applique with embroidered-gold circuit seams, but its silhouette, joints and working logic remain unmistakably mechanical. The machine is partially exploded along a controlled axis, and its modules become named “factory districts” that fold back into one assembled machine as the visitor scrolls. Show a restrained vertical or horizontal sequence marker reading “01 EXPLODED / 02 SYSTEMS ONLINE / 03 ASSEMBLED” so this visibly supports paired exploded-to-assembled scroll keyframes. Predictive-health seams wake as thin amber pulses around bearings and drive zones; do not make the machine look like a city, castle, toy, spaceship, or generic art object.
Visual world: deep night navy fabric, embroidered gold, thread white, petrol teal and a tiny amount of authentic VEEMAP orange/green. Crisp industrial typography and precise UI sit above the tactile material; stitches are deliberate structural paths, never craft-store whimsy.
Layout: full 16:9 desktop browser viewport. Accurate VEEMAP logo and wordmark in a disciplined top header; navigation “CAPABILITIES   MACHINES   ENGINEERING   CAREERS”; small action “START A PROJECT”. Hero has a powerful left-aligned headline, concise supporting copy and one dominant CTA; the central machine occupies most of the right and lower field. Label the four machine districts with clean callout cards. Include a compact bottom proof module. Generous negative space and strong responsive hierarchy.
Text (verbatim): “THE NIGHT SHIFT, ENGINEERED AWAKE.”; “High-speed special-purpose machines that see, place, report and protect their own performance.”; “TELL US ABOUT YOUR PROCESS”; “AI VISION”; “HIGH-SPEED MOTION”; “INDUSTRY 4.0 HMI”; “PREDICTIVE HEALTH”; “236 PROJECTS DELIVERED”; “SCROLL TO ASSEMBLE”.
Typography: large embroidered-thread display lettering can inspire the headline but must remain crisp and readable; pair it with a clean modern industrial sans for navigation, copy, CTA and labels. All listed text correctly spelled. No filler text.
Lighting/mood: sophisticated midnight factory, luminous gold seams and focused teal/amber subsystem pulses, tactile but controlled, premium and technical.
Constraints: real deployable web UI; central industrial machine must stay mechanically recognizable and coherent between exploded and assembled states; no proprietary RIEKE geometry or fine details; no component brands; no certifications; no testimonials; no client logos; no team size or revenue; no additional statistics; no people; no fantasy cityscape; no watermarks; no fake controls; no illegible pseudo-text.
